user.title: Choose a provider
user.description: What do you want to add?

dhl.title: Track parcel numbers (DHL, DPD, Hermes & UPS)
dhl.description: Add one or more tracking numbers (press Enter after each). Whether a number belongs to DHL, DPD, Hermes or UPS is detected automatically - this entry covers all four carriers. You can also start empty and add numbers later via the options.

data.tracking_numbers: Tracking numbers (DHL, DPD, Hermes or UPS)
data.default_postcode: Your postcode (only needed if a DPD number is protected)

dpd.title: Log in with your DPD account
dpd.description: Log in with your myDPD account. All parcels (sent, received, returns) will then be detected automatically.

amazon.title: Log in with your Amazon.de account
amazon.description:
⚠️ Security note: after login the Amazon session (cookies) is stored locally in Home Assistant in plain text, including in backups. That session grants full access to your Amazon account (orders, addresses, payment methods). Only use this if you're comfortable with that. The password itself is used only for the login and is not stored.

Note: Amazon often blocks logins from datacenter/VPS networks with a CAPTCHA - the automatic login then cannot complete.

amazon_otp.title: Amazon verification code
amazon_otp.description: Amazon requires an additional verification step. Enter the one-time code from your authenticator app, SMS or email.

hermes.title: Sign in with a Hermes account
hermes.description: Sign in with your myHermes account using the **username** you use on myhermes.de (not necessarily your email address; forgotten? Use “Request username” on myhermes.de). All parcels in your incoming-parcels overview are then discovered automatically, including the delivery window. The password is stored locally in Home Assistant (in plain text, also in backups).

dhl_account.title: Sign in with a DHL account (Experimental)
dhl_account.description:
All shipments on your DHL account are then discovered automatically. No password is stored, only DHL's sign-in session.

1. Open the developer tools (**F12**) in a new browser tab and switch to the **Console** tab (easiest in Chrome, Edge or Firefox). If the console clears during the redirect, enable "Preserve log".
2. In **that** tab, open the following link and sign in with your DHL account:

{login_url}

3. The page then appears to show nothing - that is expected. A message containing an address that starts with `dhllogin://` now shows up in the **Console** (it is not in the address bar). Copy the address or the whole line and paste it below.

The address is only valid briefly and only once. If it fails, open the link again.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to DHL again
reauth_confirm.description:
The DHL sign-in has expired or was rejected.

1. Open the developer tools (**F12**) in a new tab and switch to **Console**.
2. In that tab, open the following link and sign in:

{login_url}

3. Copy the address starting with `dhllogin://` that appears in the console (or the whole line) and paste it below.

picnic.title: Sign in with a Picnic account
picnic.description:
Sign in with your Picnic account. Your deliveries (booked window, live arrival time once the Picnic van is on its way) are then discovered automatically. **No password is stored**, only the Picnic session. If your account uses two-factor authentication you get an SMS code in the next step.

Note: this is the unofficial API of the Picnic app; it may change at any time.

picnic_code.title: Picnic verification code
picnic_code.description: Picnic sent you a verification code by SMS. Enter it here.

picnic_reauth.title: Sign in to Picnic again
picnic_reauth.description: The Picnic sign-in expired or was rejected. Please sign in again (the password is not stored).

add_tracking_number.name: Add tracking number
add_tracking_number.description: Adds a tracking number to Paketverfolgung, unless it's already tracked. The carrier (DHL, DPD, Hermes or UPS) is detected automatically.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number (DHL, DPD, Hermes or UPS).

remove_tracking_number.name: Remove tracking number
remove_tracking_number.description: Removes a tracking number from Paketverfolgung.

set_tracking_carrier.name: Set carrier
set_tracking_carrier.description: Pins a tracking number to a carrier when auto-detection gets it wrong. "auto" clears the override.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: dhl, dpd, hermes, ups or auto.

unarchive.name: Restore from archive
unarchive.description: Takes a shipment back out of the archive. It stays active (it is not archived automatically again after 24 hours) until it is archived again.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The shipment/tracking number (for Amazon the order number).

set_tracking_name.name: Set name
set_tracking_name.description: Gives a shipment a custom label. Leave empty to clear it.

set_notifications.name: Set notifications
set_notifications.description: Turns notifications on or off, separately for new shipments and status changes, and sets the targets.

on_new.name: On new shipment
on_new.description: Notify as soon as a new shipment is detected.

on_status_change.name: On status change
on_status_change.description: Notify when an existing shipment's status changes.

out_for_delivery_only.name: Only when out for delivery
out_for_delivery_only.description: Narrows the status-change notification: only once a shipment goes out for delivery or is delivered. Has no effect on "On new shipment".

short_name.name: Shorten shipment name
short_name.description: Trims long shipment names (Amazon product titles etc.) in the notification body.

set_tracking_direction.name: Set direction
set_tracking_direction.description: Marks a shipment as sent or received. "auto" clears it.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number (Amazon: the order number).

test_notification.name: Send a test notification
test_notification.description: Sends a sample notification to the configured targets, in the exact same format as a real one, with the current settings.

archive_now.name: Archive now
archive_now.description: Moves a shipment into the archive right away. Delivered shipments skip the 24-hour grace period; undelivered ones (e.g. refunded or cancelled orders) are marked as done.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number (Amazon: the order number).
